bestBets.overview: STRASBELLE is overdue for a maiden win. She has been placed in four starts leading into this and from nice draw she looks the one they have to beat. REDALUCA GIRL has plenty of early speed and she will make own luck rolling forward. If she can get some cover in this she may have last crack at leaders. TAMIEKA WARRIOR was placed ta Tamworth first-up then not disgraced at Scone last start. Drawn ideally and she can sneak a place while UNDERPIN was beaten just on a length at Inverell last start and that form good for this.

bestBets.overview: LUKE SKYWALKER jumped to the front and gave nothing else a chance winning his maiden here last start. If he gets his own way leading again he can get away with this. ZOU BIG BOY raced onm the speed and held on for minor placing at Tamworth last start. He will go forward and be tough to beat. LA NARRADORA was never in the race at Moree last start but she had been going well prior and can bounce back while FREEDOM TO ROAM got very close this track last start and she will be competitive again.

bestBets.overview: ROYAL AND READY is having first run for new stable. Will be better over a touch further but this not a difficult maiden and happy to have something each-way. EUPHORIC MISS battled on well enough in the small field at Moree last start. If she can hold that form she would give this a shake. LONG TIME LOVERS was beaten just over a length at Gilgandra last start. She is not far off a maiden while JUKEBOX EDITION is a bit one paced but he finds a winnable maiden and would not leave out of first four wagers.

BIG SHORT was placed here three starts back then been welll beaten in next couple. Should get right run behind the leaders and can sneak a place. GLORYESS chased home well enough when placed here last start at enormoous odds. He will not be that price in this while MARALAGO did enough at Moree last start to suggest he can sneak into a placing.

POISED is another coming off a last start win. Settled bit further back before making good late ground. She must be included. HIT SONG battled on well when placed two starts back then held ground last outing. He can sneak a place while WINGED is a little one paced in his races but this not a difficult affair and he can sneak into a first four spot.
